text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Nobody's here? I could've sworn I 
heard someone call me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
......Ah, maybe it's the Goddess Statue 
itself! There are plenty of folktales like 
that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything I can help with, don't 
hesitate to ask!
